modeinspect-design-engineer-skills-ai-re.description: Scores how ready a design system in code is for AI agents, then fixes what fails. Check mode is read-only and rates six criteria from a published rubric (one import path per component and no duplicates, tokens instead of hard-coded values, typed variants, docs agents read, names that match Figma, lint that enforces it) with a script, so the score repeats between runs and can be shared. Heal mode works on a branch, one commit per criterion, adds agent rules, JSDoc, deprecations and lint rules, and proposes token swaps for review. Use for "is our design system AI-ready", "score our design…

modeinspect-design-engineer-skills-compo.description: Before a shared component, variant or design token change goes into a pull request, finds every place it is used, renders each place before and after the change, and flags what changed and what broke. Use when someone asks "where is this component used", "what uses this token", "will changing the Button break anything", "what else does this affect", "check the blast radius", or edits a shared UI primitive, a cva variant, a CSS variable or a Tailwind or MUI theme value. Works on React-family frontends (Next.js, Vite; Tailwind, CSS variables, shadcn and cva, MUI).

modeinspect-design-engineer-skills-repo-.description: A designer's first run in an unfamiliar frontend repo. Detects the stack, installs dependencies, gets the dev server running and proves a page renders, or stops with the exact error and the most likely fix. Then maps where tokens, components and routes live and sorts the codebase into safe to change, change with care, and ask an engineer first. Use when the user says "set up this repo", "get this running", "how do I run this locally", "I'm new to this codebase", "onboard me", "where are the components", "where are the design tokens", "what can I safely change", or opens a production repo for…

modeinspect-design-engineer-skills-revie.description: Helps a designer review an engineer's UI pull request. Opens the deploy preview or runs the branch locally, lists the screens and states the change touches, walks those states with the designer, and drafts review comments an engineer can act on. Each comment says what is wrong, where, why it matters, how to fix it and whether it blocks the merge. Comments are posted to GitHub only after the designer says yes. Use when a designer says "review this PR as a designer", "design review PR 482", "design QA this branch", "check the engineer's UI changes", "help me leave feedback on this pull…

Turns a UI change you made in an existing codebase into a pull request an engineer can review. Scopes a branch to the change and splits off unrelated edits. Captures before and after screenshots per breakpoint and theme from two running copies of the app. Writes a description for engineers listing the components and tokens touched, the states checked and what is out of scope. Use when the user says "make this a PR", "open a PR for my UI change", "get this ready for review", "add before and after screenshots", "write the PR description", "split my changes" or "hand this to engineering". Opens…

modeinspect-design-engineer-skills-visua.description: Visual QA of a branch before review. Works out which routes the branch changed, opens each one on localhost and on a baseline (the production URL the user gives, or the default branch run locally from a worktree), drives hover, focus, dark mode and narrow widths, and reports every difference with before, after and diff screenshots. Separates style changes the branch made from content that differs only because the data differs, and flags changed lines that show no visible difference at all. Use when the user says "visual QA", "QA my branch", "compare my branch to production", "compare with…
